name: Campingplatz Bergheimat
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Bergheimat is located on the edge of Bad Hindelang in the scenic Oberallgäu region. The park provides pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, alongside holiday rental units. Guests can reach the town centre with its shops and restaurants in just a few minutes. Terraced grounds ensure panoramic alpine vistas, supported by clean sanitary amenities, a children's playground, and an on-site grocery store.
